Khap Khap Thai Bmt
Aug 2026 • Couples
This is one of the restaurants I've been to quite a lot in BMT. Initially, I went to try it because I saw it was a Thai food place, and after eating, I found it suited my taste, so I started dropping by from time to time. Delicious food, authentic Thai flavors. The staff are cute and helpful with any questions. The space of the quán is suitable for eating with friends and family, and it's comfortable for chatting. If you like Thai food, I think you can try Khap Khap.
